title: Hyundai India's record IPO: institutions piled in, retail stayed away
short: Hyundai India's record IPO: institutions in, retail out
dek: In October 2024, Hyundai Motor India raised ₹27,870 crore, beating LIC's record. The day-by-day bids show who wanted it, and who didn't.
card: India's biggest IPO of 2024 raised ₹27,870 crore. Retail investors bid for only half their quota.
